why: T31 gate: the new metric must be computable from a shipped pool, and it must read far below the gen_validity that the same run reported.
definition: molecule_validity = fraction of generated samples whose SMILES (a) RDKit parses and sanitises, (b) has exactly one fragment, (c) contains one of the six target metals, (d) has >1 heavy atom. Same denominator as gen_validity.
reading: On c8 the same pool reported gen_validity 1.000/1.000/1.000 (molmetal/reports/cfm_c8_fullgen_2026_10_24 master.log + per-epoch block). molecule_validity on those rows is the single-fragment rate: the metal is present in 100% of parses, so the gap is entirely disconnected output. The metric therefore moves by 0.15 absolute between epoch 1 and epoch 2 where the parse rate moves by 0.000.
denominator_note: gen_single_fragment_ratio (summarise_decode_chemistry) divides by the PARSED rows; molecule_validity divides by every sample drawn. On both shipped pools 100% of rows parsed, so the two are numerically identical and this artifact records that equality rather than hiding it. The denominators diverge as soon as a sample fails to parse, and the full denominator is the honest one for 'how many of the N samples are molecules'.

kill_criterion_check.criterion: T31 kill: if molecule_validity is exactly equal to gen_single_fragment_ratio, the new field has no increment.
kill_criterion_check.result: EQUAL on both shipped pools (metal present in 100% of parses).
kill_criterion_check.decision: KEEP, because the two answer different denominators and only molecule_validity is a single pass/fail predicate a gate can consume. Recorded so the equality is not read as independent evidence.
kill_criterion_check.metal_conjunct_nonvacuous_because: metal_missing_rate is a live field on the same summary (a connected organic fragment with the metal dropped is the failure mode it was added for); it was 0 on these two pools only.

wfa107_control_epoch0.note: derived from recorded per-epoch fields, not from a SMILES pool

recorded_field_derivation.why: T31's done_when names wfa107_ring_prior_ab control/epoch0: that run reported gen_validity 1.0 while its samples were 0% single-fragment. No SMILES pool was shipped for it, so this row is DERIVED from the per-epoch fields the run recorded, not recomputed from SMILES.
recorded_field_derivation.derivation: molecule_validity is a conjunction: parse AND single-fragment AND metal-present AND >1 heavy atom. gen_single_fragment_ratio is 0.000, so the conjunction is 0.000 regardless of the other three conjuncts; no bound is needed on the unrecorded n_heavy conjunct.
recorded_field_derivation.gate_result: PASS — molecule_validity 0.000 where the same epoch's gen_validity is 1.000
